records.name: FEST App
records.category: Festival & event app (organizer SaaS + attendee discovery)
records.description: FEST App brings festivals together with simple technology for teams and audiences. Attendees discover festivals, artists, lineups, schedules and tickets worldwide; organizers manage schedules, artists, maps, notifications and more from a single web ecosystem (Backstage). Replaces paper programs and improves attendee engagement.
records.target_market: Festival, conference and event organizers and their attendees; worldwide

pricing.notes: Free plan as a first step; Pro and Premium add stronger partner visibility, advanced maps, multilingual content, statistics, app store featuring and web integrations.

features: Wix add-on to sync artists/schedules/events/places to festival website

verification.notes: Confirmed from official site and organizer/pricing pages. Company financials/founders not publicly stated.

records.name: HighApe
records.description: India's go-out / events discovery platform. Helps users find local experiences by interest, location and social circle, filter and book tickets, and chat with others to plan outings. Started with nightlife and expanded to DJ nights, concerts, activities, travel, treks, workshops, food & drinks and more.
records.target_market: India — major cities incl. Bangalore, Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Hyderabad

funding.notes: Bootstrapped for the first two years with positive unit economics, then raised from angels. Figures per third-party profiles; verify before relying on them.

pricing.notes: App is free to download; revenue via ticketing/bookings.

features: Social discovery / chat to plan outings
Broad categories (nightlife, concerts, activities, travel, workshops, food & drinks)

verification.notes: Product facts confirmed from official site and app stores. Founder/funding figures come from third-party databases and are flagged for double-checking.
